mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 4 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 8, low 3.

Neuralink, Elon Musk's brain-computer company, has received FDA approval to begin an advanced clinical study testing the safety of its brain-implant device in the United States.

Kosovo's justice ministry says eight women were murdered between January and October 2026, and more than 2,300 cases of domestic violence were recorded, with the Arlinda Zekaj case demanding a full investigation.

European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced that Kosovo, Serbia and Bosnia will lose portions of the Western Balkans Growth Plan funding, which will be reallocated to three countries that have made the greatest progress.

Kosovo Democratic Party deputy chair Vlora Çitaku welcomed the European Union's readiness to consult on the draft Special Law, stating that the authorities are prepared to engage with EU officials.

Kosovar forward Vedat Muriqi scored the only goal as Fenerbahçe defeated Shakhtar Donetsk, underscoring his impressive recent statistical performance.
